_meta.purpose: Master reference for India-eligibility signal, separate from companies.json (which is just ATS-fetch slugs). Update this file as you find new evidence -- it's meant to grow over time.

confirmed_india_remote._note: Direct evidence of 'India Remote' listings. Highest confidence tier.

global_hiring_role_dependent._note: Confirmed globally-remote hiring model, but individual roles can still carry restrictions.

known_not_india_eligible._note: Research flagged these as commonly restricting to US/EU/Canada. Hard-excluded regardless of listing text.

eligibility_varies_by_listing._note: No blanket adjustment, evaluate each listing normally.

known_ats_slugs._note: Sourced from actual citation URLs in research, not guessed.

talent_marketplaces_not_ats._note: Matching platforms, not company job boards -- no ATS API without a dedicated scraper (not built yet).
